description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams, used to specify filtering and sorting parameters for searching claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes constants for filtering options, properties for various filter criteria, and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for filtering and sorting claim request search results based on various criteria such as employee status, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'claimRequest.referenceId' and sort order descending.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current value for the includeEmployees filter, indicating whether to include only current, past, or both employee claim requests.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID filter value.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID filter value.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the event ID filter value.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the event ID filter value.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the date range filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the date range filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the date range filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the date range filter, adjusting time to 23:59:59 if a DateTime object is provided.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers filtered.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.
